202001: Walter Smith III CMA Premiere Ensemble feat. Jason Moran, Matt Stevens, Matt Brewer and Bill Stewart: Acclaimed tenor saxophonist and composer Walter Smith III returns to Smoke, debuting a phenomenal group featuring pianist Jason Moran, guitarist Matt Stevens, bassist Matt Brewer, and drummer Bill Stewart. Smith will premiere a major new work commissioned through Chamber Music America's prestigious New Jazz Works program, supported by the Doris Duke Foundation. One of the most compelling voices in contemporary jazz, Smith has spent nearly two decades at the forefront of the music as both a bandleader and sought-after collaborator.
